capabilities: Chat with any OpenAI-compatible provider across five persistent sessions
Create, edit, rename, and find/replace notes through tool actions with confirmation prompts
Run ranked vault search weighted by title, heading, tag, and body
Search the web, fetch pages, and download files into the vault
Attach, compress, and OCR images, routing vision input to a multimodal model
extras: Full documentation lives on an external wiki rather than the README. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. File-changing actions prompt for confirmation unless YOLO mode is enabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, so users who want an LLM assistant acting on their notes must supply their own key and interface.
